name: PAN: Physics of Atomic Nuclei (FRIB, Michigan State University)
org: Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB), Michigan State University
what_you_do: Spend a week at a world-leading nuclear physics lab. You explore nuclear astrophysics research, run your own experiments, and learn how the science is used in society.
who_can_apply: Current high school students in the United States.
pay_detail: Free. The program, room and board are free for all participants.
deadline_text: The program takes place in late July each year. Applications are open early December through March. Exact 2027 dates are not posted on the page I could read.
how_to_apply: Apply through the program page linked from the MSU Spartan Youth listing. Contact: Zach Constan, constan@frib.msu.edu or 517-908-7363.
notes: The FRIB program page (frib.msu.edu) did not load for me because the site blocks automated readers, so this card rests on Michigan State University's Spartan Youth Programs listing only. Confirm dates, the application link, cost and any extra requirements on the FRIB page before you plan.
